description:
**AI Video \& Motion Automation Engineer (Intern)** 




  





**Company:** 
 Glido Labs
 



**Location:** 
 Noida, India (Onsite / Hybrid)
 



**Role type:** 
 Internship
 



**Stipend:** 
 INR 10,000 to INR 15,000 per month
 



**Team:** 
 Engineering / Media Tech
 



  





**About the role :** 




 We are hiring an AI Video \& Motion Automation Engineer Intern to join our
 



 media tech team. You will design and build code\-driven video generation
 



 engines, combining React\-based video rendering (Remotion) with HTML, CSS
 



 and GSAP\-based agentic video frameworks (HyperFrames by HeyGen), dynamic
 



 kinetic captioning systems, motion graphics, and AI generative media APIs
 



 to produce automated video pipelines at scale.
 



  





**Please note:** 
 this is a specialised video engine, motion graphics and media
 



 code role. It is a strong fit if you have hands\-on experience with
 



 programmatic video, motion graphics, kinetic captioning and frame\-level
 



 rendering (Remotion, HyperFrames, GSAP, FFmpeg). It is likely not the right
 



 fit if your experience is limited to general LLM automation or chatbot
 



 workflows built on n8n or Zapier.
 



  





**What you will do :** 




 \- Build programmatic, code\-driven video templates using Remotion
 



  (React and TypeScript).
 



 \- Develop agentic motion graphic compositions using HyperFrames
 



  (HTML, CSS, GSAP by HeyGen) for AI\-driven video generation.
 



 \- Design dynamic kinetic captioning engines with word\-level audio
 



  synchronisation and automated subtitle positioning.
 



 \- Create motion graphic templates, lower thirds, callouts and animated
 



  typography using web technologies.
 



 \- Build automated media rendering pipelines connecting AI models for
 



  voiceovers, lip\-sync, captioning and asset generation.
 



 \- Manage serverless video rendering clusters using Remotion Lambda or
 



  Headless Chrome with FFmpeg.
 



 \- Integrate video automation engines into custom APIs and media workflows
 



  to generate video content at scale.
 



  





**Must\-have skills :** 




 \- Programmatic video frameworks: hands\-on experience with Remotion
 



  (React / TypeScript) and/or HyperFrames by HeyGen (HTML / CSS / GSAP).
 



 \- Motion graphics: strong foundation in motion design principles,
 



  keyframing, typography timing, lower thirds and animated overlays.
 



 \- Kinetic captioning and subtitles: word\-level sync captions,
 



  audio\-to\-text timing alignment and animated subtitle styles.
 



 \- Web animation: solid understanding of GSAP, CSS keyframes and
 



  HTML Canvas animations.
 



 \- Core development: strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript and React.
 



 \- AI media APIs: experience with OpenAI, ElevenLabs, Replicate, Fal.ai,
 



  HeyGen or Deepgram.
 



 \- Media stack: familiarity with FFmpeg, media encoding formats and
 



  frame\-accurate rendering.
 



 \- AI coding tools: comfortable using assistants such as Antigravity IDE
 



  or Cursor to rapidly build video compositions.
 



  





**Nice to have :** 




 \- Lottie animations or Three.js inside web video compositions.
 



 \- Serverless video deployments on AWS Lambda, GCP or Vercel.
 



 \- Background in Adobe After Effects, Premiere Pro or similar motion
 



  design tools.
 



 \- Familiarity with Python automation scripts.
 



  





**Who tends to do well here :** 




 \- Engineers who bridge code, motion graphics, subtitle engines and
 



  AI video.
 



 \- Builders who have shipped automated video tools, AI video generators
 



  or dynamic visual tools.
 



 \- High\-ownership developers who experiment with open\-source media
 



  frameworks and get things done.
 



  





**How to apply :** 




 Apply through the link below, or send your CV along with links to your
 



 work (GitHub, demos, reels or rendered samples).
 



  





**Apply here:** 





 https://careers.glidolabs.com/jobs/ai\-video\-motion\-automation\-engineer\-intern

title: AI Integration Engineer – Digital Transformation (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech\-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.
   

  

 Joining the People \& Organization Digital Transformation team, you will work directly with the Head of Digital Transformation and a close\-knit team of four engineers based in Berlin. Your work will span automation engineering, AI application deployment on top of HR systems — with direct impact on how Flix manages its people technology globally. Are you an engineer who knows how to turn AI ideas into real\-world applications—deploying Claude\-based solutions, building integrations, and putting the right security and governance in place? If you’ve built innovative AI products, like those emerging from HR AI Day and beyond, and have the engineering mindset to take them from idea to scalable solution, we’d love to hear from you.
   

  

 This is a pure technical role. There is no administrative overhead, no time\-critical firefighting and no expectation of HR domain expertise on day one — we can teach you the domain. This is an exciting, problem\-solving\-focused role at the intersection of AI, automation, and HR solution architecture. While the technical skills can be developed, what we cannot teach is the engineering mindset, depth of integration expertise, and natural instinct for automation that this role demands.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role based in Gurugram OR Bangalore with a minimum office presence of 3 days per week. The role has a Europe and APAC\-facing scope, with regular collaboration across Central European time zones.
   

  

**About The Role**
* Lead the technical workstream supporting internal automation projects —evaluating global HR system options, assessing integration complexity, mapping data dependencies and supporting potential migration execution from Workday or equivalent enterprise HR platforms.
* Design and build automation and integration workflows using n8n,UiPath and Python — including multi\-step orchestration, exception handling, retries, monitoring, alerting and structured documentation.
* Build and maintain enterprise system integrations using REST APIs,OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven patterns across the HR technology landscape.
* Develop secure AI integrations connecting platforms such as Claude with HRIS and enterprise systems using MCP servers, connectors, plugins and agent frameworks — with appropriate access controls and user\-level permissions.
* Deploy and operate internal applications and AI\-powered tools on Flix's hosting infrastructure (AWS), including RBAC/ABAC access models, secrets management, credential rotation and audit logging.
* Analyse business processes end\-to\-end, identify automation opportunities and design scalable target\-state architectures that can support both the evaluation phase and eventual migration or implementation execution.
* Engage with cross\-functional stakeholders across Europe and APAC —translating complex technical requirements into clear solution designs and project deliverables across 3–6 month project scopes.


**About You**
* 6–7\+ years of hands\-on professional experience in automation engineering, systems integration, solution architecture or AI application development. Exceptional mid\-level candidates with strong technical depth will also be considered.
* Demonstrable experience building and delivering automation workflows and enterprise integrations — this is an engineering role, not a data analytics or reporting role. Experience in Python, n8n and UiPath is essential.
* Strong working knowledge of API design and integration patterns —REST APIs, OAuth 2\.0, webhooks, SFTP and event\-driven architectures.
* Hands\-on experience deploying and operating applications on AWS,including Lambda, API Gateway, Bedrock, Glue, Secrets Manager and CI/CD pipeline management.
* Solid software engineering fundamentals — Git/GitHub, Docker,structured release management and familiarity with security practices including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC and credential handling.
* Experience with Workday or enterprise HRIS platforms (configuration, integration or migration) is a strong advantage and a meaningful differentiator — though not an absolute requirement if your automation and integration fundamentals are strong.
* Comfort working across European and APAC time zones, collaborating with a Berlin\-based team and contributing to strategic cross\-functional initiatives.
* n8n Level 1 or Level 2 certification is strongly preferred.


 We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!
   

  

**What We Offer**
* Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers \+ 12 discount vouchers for friends \& family.
* Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year.
* Hybrid work model: We are an office\-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life.
* Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members.
* Learning \& Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert\-led sessions to grow your skills.
* Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career.


 To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations \- Flix Career
   

  

**Why Join Flix?**
 At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture \- giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
   

  

 As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.
   

  

 If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 Expedia Global Payments (EGP) is looking for top engineering talent to help drive the development of our payments platform, seamlessly roll out new payments methods, and to continuously raise the bar on our operational excellence and engineering practices. Our services are the nexus of a globally distributed system that spans many organizations. Our roadmap is deep and contains several innovative programs designed to make our services fault tolerant, reduce the cost of payment processing, and improve customer experience. This includes compensating for downstream services that are not in Expedia's control. We are also looking to use cloud computing (AWS) to further solidify our infrastructure. This opportunity presents you with great technical challenges and the ability to have a tremendous business impact. We do this accurately and at scale, processing over $100 billion payments in 60\+ currencies in over 155 countries every year across diverse payment options.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build end\-to\-end backend solutions for Payments, that are scalable, resilient, and performant.
* Own and evolve core payment services and workflows, including payment session lifecycle, payment\-method orchestration, and downstream service integrations.
* Build and enhance backend APIs and service interfaces using Kotlin/Java and modern service frameworks, with strong emphasis on clean contracts, backward compatibility, and operational reliability.
* Develop and support GraphQL, gRPC, and REST\-based integrations that power payment experiences across multiple Expedia Group brands and checkout surfaces.
* Contribute to distributed system design for high\-volume, multi\-tenant, 24x7 payment flows, balancing latency, availability, security, and maintainability.
* Build robust integrations with payment providers, internal platforms, and shared infrastructure while ensuring fault tolerance and graceful degradation.
* Take strong ownership of production systems, including monitoring, alerting, on\-call participation, incident response, and root cause resolution.
* Build and enhance observability through logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and operational playbooks to proactively detect and prevent issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with urgency, minimizing customer, partner, and business impact in high\-transaction environments.
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment safety, and engineering effectiveness through CI/CD, rollback strategies, feature flags, test automation, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, frontend engineers, partner teams, and platform teams to deliver reliable, intuitive, and scalable payment capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers and drive engineering best practices across backend design, coding standards, testing, operational excellence, and incident management.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design decisions across the team and broader payments ecosystem.
* Influence cross\-functional delivery and act as a subject matter expert for backend payment architecture, scalability, and service reliability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on backend engineering using Java in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing backend services, including system design (with low\-level design), API contracts, and data modeling for RDBMS\-backed applications.
* Practical exposure to at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and associated services for deploying, running, and monitoring backend services at scale.
* Demonstrated responsibility for owning and supporting backend components in production, including working with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of backend service development, testing, or operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep expertise in Java\-based microservice development using frameworks such as Spring Boot, including experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong RDBMS experience that goes beyond basic CRUD usage, including working with stored procedures, performance tuning, and systematically migrating database\-resident logic into application services.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale, business\-critical backend systems in a cloud environment (such as AWS), with a track record of using observability tooling to drive operational excellence and reliability.
* Demonstrated use of AI\-augmented development or operations (for example, code\-generation assistants, intelligent alerting, or anomaly detection) and the ability to safely integrate AI/ML‑enabled solutions into backend services to improve developer productivity, system stability, or customer outcomes.

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

The official place to find and apply for roles is https://careers.expediagroup.com/jobs/.

 With Aftershoot, it takes an hour.

Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top\-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.
   

  

 Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.
   

  

**Description**
 United's Digital Technology team is comprised of many talented individuals all working together with cutting\-edge technology to build the best airline in the history of aviation. Our team designs, develops and maintains massively scaling technology solutions brought to life with innovative architectures, data analytics, and digital solutions.
   

  

**Job Overview And Responsibilities**
 As a Senior Automation Test Engineer for Digital Technology at United Airlines, you will be responsible for the delivery of enterprise software testing projects and programs, operation and capital projects with automation first approach. In this role, you will design, implement, and execute automation test approach and strategies and frameworks for all deliverables. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with Quality Managers and Quality Leads to implement quality governance, quality gates, risk assessment, production signoffs, key metrics (KPIs), and tools selection.
   

  

 You should have excellent problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
   

  

 Additionally, you should be well versed in using Gen AI to bring in innovation/efficiency in your role and responsibilities.
   

  

* Lead the design and implementation of automation and manual test strategies for various software and systems utilizing best practices and standards.
* Collaborate with software developers, QE analysts, and system engineers to identify system requirements and ensure quality is met from test planning to production deployment with automation first approach.
* Own and maintain automation artifacts, tools, licenses \& framework. Govern automation standards \& best practices. Conduct automation audits and assess ROIs.
* Manage and mitigate testing related risks and issues.
* Identify and maintain testing KPI's, track trends and own the power BI reports.
* Integrate automation frameworks with continuous integration and deployment pipelines
* Leverage AI when contributing to end\-to\-end testing (Automation frameworks etc.)


**This position is offered on local terms and conditions within United’s wholly owned subsidiary United Airlines Business Services Pvt. Ltd. Expatriate assignments and sponsorship for employment visas, even on a time\-limited visa status, will not be awarded.**
**Qualifications**
**What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):**
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Management Information Systems and/or equivalent work experience
* 4 years of relevant work experience
* 6\+ years of Test Automation experience.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner


 ISTQB / CSTE or similar
   

  

* Programming Language expertise – Java
* Design, Develop and maintain scalable hybrid test automation frameworks (BDD/JUnit/TestNG)
* Ability to architect solutions across the stack: Web(Selenium), API(RestAssured), Mobile(Appium)
* Experience with Containerization and Cloud Execution Grids (BrowserStack, Sauce labs, Selenium Grid)
* Design Patterns and Framework Design Concepts
* Agile \& Waterfall Methodologies and STLC across, Release Management
* Create/Support DevOps CICD implementation in AWS/GCP or similar
* Test Data Modeling and Data level testing with RDBMS or NoSQL based structure
* Able to work with distributed global teams.


**What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):**
* Master's degree in computer science, Information Systems
* Airline Domain Knowledge
* UFT/AccelQ/SeeTest
* Python, PyTest
* AccelQ
* Prompt Engineering
* GHCP, Code Assist

title: Sr Test Engineer - Automation (Selenium + Java + Playwright +AI Testing)

Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome\-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team.

 Gartner is looking for a well\-rounded and motivated test engineer to join its agile, scrum\-based Sales and Services technology team which is responsible for testing web, agentic and API applications and integrations to support its continuous delivery. You will contribute to maintenance and development of test automation frameworks and leverage AI tools for testing deliverables.  Strong IT professional with 4\-6 yrs of experience in testing applications via both manual and automated tests. title: Graduate Trainee – Technology & Solutions
description:
**Graduate Trainee – Technology \& Solutions** 




**Company:** 
 SkillsNCR
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram
 



**Job Type:** 
 Full\-time \| In\-person
 



**Experience:** 
 Freshers / 0–2 years only
 



**Eligible Degrees:** 
 BCA / MCA / B.Tech / BE or equivalent technology degree
 



  





**About SkillsNCR** 




**SkillsNCR is building practical, industry\-oriented learning programs and technology\-enabled solutions designed to help students and recent graduates become workplace\-ready.** 




**We are looking for a Graduate Trainee – Technology \& Solutions** 
 who can grow with us across technology development, product support, data, AI, databases and technical learning.
 



 This is not purely a teaching role.
 



  





 You will be expected to:
 



**Learn → Build → Test → Support → Explain** 




**You may work on SkillsNCR's internal platforms, student\-facing applications, assessments, automation, data systems, AI\-enabled solutions and technical learning programs.** 




**You are not expected to know everything on Day 1\. We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, curiosity, ownership and the ability to learn quickly.** 




  





**What You Will Work On** 




**Depending on your strengths and business requirements, you may work across:** 



* SQL and databases
* MySQL / PostgreSQL
* Python
* Data analysis
* Data engineering fundamentals
* Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning
* Generative AI and AI tools
* APIs and integrations
* Cloud platforms
* Git / GitHub
* Excel and data handling
* Automation
* Web applications and internal tools
* Testing and troubleshooting
* Technical support
* Student assessment platforms
* Learning management and technology solutions



 You are not required to be an expert in all these areas.
 



  





**Build \& Technology** 



* Help build and improve SkillsNCR technology solutions.
* Work on internal tools, dashboards, applications and automation.
* Write and maintain SQL queries.
* Work with databases and datasets.
* Build small applications, scripts and utilities.
* Support integrations between systems and APIs.
* Experiment with AI and Generative AI use cases.
* Assist in developing AI\-enabled learning and assessment solutions.
* Contribute to product enhancements and new features.
* Document technical workflows and solutions.



  





**Testing \& Support** 



* Test new features before release.
* Identify bugs and reproduce technical issues.
* Help troubleshoot application, database and user issues.
* Support students, trainers and internal teams when they face technical problems.
* Maintain issue logs and track resolutions.
* Help improve the reliability and usability of SkillsNCR platforms.
* Work with the team to diagnose and resolve technical issues.



  





**Learning \& Training** 




**As your technical capability develops, you may also:** 



* Help students during practical labs.
* Explain SQL, Python, databases, AI and related topics.
* Create exercises and technical assignments.
* Review student projects.
* Conduct demonstrations and practical sessions.
* Support technical assessments.
* Mentor students on projects and problem solving.



 Teaching responsibilities will depend on your strengths and will grow gradually with your technical experience.
 



  





**Who Should Apply** 




**You may be a good fit if you:** 



* Have completed BCA, MCA, B.Tech, BE or an equivalent technology degree.
* Are a fresher or have no more than 2 years of professional experience.
* Have basic programming knowledge.
* Understand the fundamentals of SQL, databases or software development.
* Are interested in Data, AI, Cloud or software technologies.
* Enjoy solving problems.
* Are comfortable learning new tools independently.
* Can communicate clearly in English and Hindi.
* Are comfortable helping others understand technical concepts.
* Are willing to work full\-time from Gurugram.
* Are comfortable working in an early\-stage startup environment.



  





**What We Value More Than Experience** 




**For this role, we care more about what you can learn and build than the number of years you have worked.** 




**We would like to see things such as:** 



* College projects
* Personal projects
* GitHub repositories
* Python projects
* SQL projects
* Websites or applications you have built
* Data analysis projects
* AI / GenAI experiments
* Automation projects
* Hackathons
* Internships
* Technical presentations



  





 Even a small project is valuable if you can explain:
 



**What problem did you solve?** 




**How did you build it?** 




**What went wrong?** 




**How did you fix it?** 




**You Do Not Need to Know Everything** 




  





**We expect Graduate Trainees to learn.** 




**If we give you a technology you have never used before, we want to see whether you can:** 



1. Understand the fundamentals.
2. Research independently.
3. Build a working solution.
4. Test it.
5. Troubleshoot problems.
6. Document what you did.
7. Explain it to someone else.



 That ability is more important to us than knowing every technology listed in this JD.
 



**This Role May Not Be For You If** 



* You have more than 2 years of professional experience.
* You are looking primarily for a remote role.
* You only want a teaching job.
* You only want a software development job with no user interaction.
* You are unwilling to work outside one specific technology.
* You prefer theory over hands\-on work.
* You are uncomfortable troubleshooting problems.
* You need detailed instructions for every task.
* You are interested mainly in collecting certifications.



  





**Why Join SkillsNCR** 




**As an early member of the team, you may get exposure to multiple areas instead of being limited to one narrow technology.** 




**You could work on:** 



* Data and databases
* AI and Generative AI
* Internal software platforms
* Student applications
* Automation
* Assessments
* Analytics
* Product testing
* Technical support
* Learning content
* Technical mentoring



 You will get an opportunity to understand how a technology solution is designed, built, tested, supported and used by real learners and internal teams.
 



  





 Strong performers can gradually move towards roles such as:
 



**Software / Technology Associate \| Data Analyst \| AI Associate \| Solution Engineer \| Product Support Engineer \| Technical Trainer \| Technology Mentor** 




**What Matters Most** 




**We are looking for graduates who can become dependable problem solvers.** 




**Our expectation is simple:** 




**Learn it. Build it. Test it. Fix it. Explain it.** 




**If that sounds like the kind of career you want to build, we would like to hear from you.** 




  





**Applications are open only to fresh graduates and candidates with 0–2 years of experience.** 




**Show us what you can build, solve and learn — not just what you have studied.**

title: GDS Cyber - Frontier AI-VMDR - Senior Engineer
description:

 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services:**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**Role Overview:**
 As a Senior Cyber AI Engineer within EY's Global Delivery Services (GDS) Cybersecurity Team, you will drive the convergence of Cybersecurity, Vulnerability Management, and Artificial Intelligence to build intelligent, scalable, and automated security operations.
   

  

 You will design, implement, and enhance AI\-enabled vulnerability management programs that leverage machine learning, generative AI, intelligent analytics, and automation to improve risk identification, prioritization, remediation, and executive decision\-making across enterprise environments.
   

  

 In addition to delivering client engagements, you will help shape EY’s AI\-driven Cybersecurity capabilities, contribute to thought leadership, and mentor teams on applying AI responsibly and securely within cyber operations.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As organizations rapidly adopt AI and cloud\-native technologies, cybersecurity teams must evolve beyond traditional vulnerability management approaches. You will help clients transform their security operations by applying AI and data\-driven techniques to vulnerability management lifecycle
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 AI Security \& Guardrails
   

  

* Design, implement, and maintain enterprise AI security guardrails.
* Develop controls to mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, model abuse, and adversarial attacks.
* Define AI trust, safety, governance, and security standards.
* Evaluate AI applications against organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Establish policies and enforcement mechanisms for responsible AI usage.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for AI applications, agents, and autonomous workflows.
* Define secure deployment patterns for LLM, RAG, and agent\-based solutions.
* Establish security logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities for AI systems.


 AI Red Teaming
   

  

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI\-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI\-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat\-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.


 Engineering \& Automation
   

  

* Develop Python\-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.


**Additional AI Security Skills**
* Application Security (OWASP Top 10\)
* Secure SDLC / DevSecOps
* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management


 Additional Security Frameworks
   

  

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks


**To Qualify for the Role**
**Education**
* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA


**Experience**
* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2\+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs


**Preferred Certifications**
* CEH, CISSP, CISM, OSCP, GIAC, Azure AI, Open AI, AWS ML, Azure ML certifications


**What We Look For**
**Professionals who can bridge the gap between cybersecurity and artificial intelligence by:**
* Building AI\-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next\-generation cyber transformation initiatives.


 The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.

title: Nutanix Automation Engineer
description:
**Details:**
 The Nutanix Automation Engineer exists to create leverage. Migration at scale and ongoing platform operations both generate large volumes of repetitive, error\-prone manual work \- pre\-migration checks, bulk VM configuration, post\-cutover validation, health reporting, provisioning, and configuration drift correction. This role converts that work into scripted, API\-driven, version\-controlled automation so the migration team moves faster with fewer defects and the support team absorbs more estate without adding heads. The role is measured in hours removed and errors prevented, not in scripts written.
   

  

**Migration Automation**
* Automate pre\-migration discovery and readiness checks \- bulk inventory extraction, snapshot and VMware Tools state validation, disk and configuration compatibility screening, and blocker reporting per wave.
* Script bulk operations against Nutanix Move and the Nutanix APIs \- migration plan creation, batch VM addition, replication status polling, and progress and exception reporting to the Project Manager.
* Build post\-migration validation automation: guest reachability, service and port checks, VirtIO and driver state, disk presence, backup re\-registration, and monitoring agent check\-in \- producing a pass/fail evidence artifact per VM that supports application owner sign\-off.
* Automate post\-cutover configuration \- categories and tags, protection policy assignment, affinity rules, and resource right\-sizing recommendations based on measured utilization.


**Operational and Platform Automation**
* Develop scheduled health and compliance automation \- NCC result collection and parsing, cluster resiliency and capacity reporting, snapshot and replication compliance checks, and upgrade\-readiness assessment.
* Build self\-service and workflow automation for routine requests: VM provisioning from standard templates, resource changes, decommissioning, and access requests, with approval gates preserved.
* Implement event\-driven automation using Prism Central Playbooks (X\-Play) or equivalent \- automated triage, enrichment, and remediation for well\-understood recurring alerts.
* Integrate the Nutanix platform with the client's ITSM and CMDB \- automated ticket creation with contextual detail, asset and configuration item synchronization, and closure/status write\-back.
* Build operational reporting and dashboards \- capacity runway, migration progress, incident and change volume, and platform health trending \- for both client leadership and Stefanini governance.


**Engineering Practice and Code Quality**
* Manage all automation as code in the client's or Stefanini's version control system, with branching, peer review, and change history \- no untracked scripts on jump boxes.
* Apply infrastructure\-as\-code practice where appropriate \- Terraform Nutanix provider or Ansible collections for repeatable, declarative configuration of clusters, categories, networks, and VMs.
* Implement safe automation design: idempotency, dry\-run and reporting\-only modes, explicit confirmation for destructive operations, structured logging, and error handling that fails loudly rather than silently.
* Handle credentials and secrets correctly \- no embedded passwords or API keys; integrate with the client's approved secrets management and service account model, with least\-privilege scoping.
* Document every automation asset: purpose, prerequisites, parameters, expected output, failure modes, and rollback, so ownership can transfer without the original author.
* Contribute reusable, client\-agnostic automation assets back to the Stefanini Nutanix practice library, accelerating the next engagement.

 hardware or device matrices, multi\-tenant SaaS, SSO/SAML/SCIM, mobile or kiosk testing.
 




  





**WHO THIS ISN’T FOR**

Our constraints are different — smaller team, faster cycles, stranger test surface, higher stakes per defect. A playbook built for a twenty\-person QA org and a two\-week regression cycle won’t survive contact with how we work.
 





 It’s also not a role for a pure QA management profile. If your experience is running testing as a separate function or a services engagement — headcount, test case volume, defect throughput — this will be a poor fit in both directions.
 




  






 We care much less about test case counts, certifications, or deep expertise in one specific tool. We care much more about how you decide what’s worth testing when you can’t test everything, what you do when there’s no spec and the person who built the feature has moved on, and whether you can change your mind when the evidence changes.
 




  





  





**WHAT WE OFFER**
